class ReactionRepairAuthorizationTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    sign_in_as users(:kevin)
    @comment = comments(:logo_agreement_jz)
  end

  test 'a forged ID never deletes the callers own reaction' do
    own = @comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:kevin), content: 'mine')
    other = @comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:david), content: 'theirs')
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(@comment.card, @comment, other), as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :forbidden
    assert Reaction.exists?(own.id)
    assert Reaction.exists?(other.id)
  end

  test 'a reaction from another comment is not found and neither record changes' do
    own = @comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:kevin), content: 'mine')
    other_comment = comments(:logo_agreement_kevin)
    other = other_comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:kevin), content: 'elsewhere')
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(@comment.card, @comment, other), as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :not_found
    assert Reaction.exists?(own.id)
    assert Reaction.exists?(other.id)
  end

  test 'a missing reaction ID never falls back to an owned record' do
    own = @comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:kevin), content: 'mine')
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(@comment.card, @comment, 'missing'), as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :not_found
    assert Reaction.exists?(own.id)
  end

  test 'a comment cannot be addressed through another card' do
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      post card_comment_reactions_path(cards(:layout), @comment), params: { reaction: { content: 'wrong' } },
                                                                  as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test 'an inaccessible card cannot receive or lose reactions' do
    card, comment = Current.with(account: @comment.account, user: users(:kevin)) do
      private_card = boards(:private).cards.create!(title: 'Private', creator: users(:kevin), status: :published)
      [private_card, private_card.comments.create!(body: 'Private comment', creator: users(:kevin))]
    end
    reaction = comment.reactions.create!(content: 'private', creator: users(:kevin))
    logout_and_sign_in_as users(:jz)
    refute users(:jz).accessible_cards.exists?(card.id)
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      post card_comment_reactions_path(card, comment), params: { reaction: { content: 'wrong' } }, as: :turbo_stream
      assert_response :not_found
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(card, comment, reaction), as: :turbo_stream
      assert_response :not_found
    end
    assert Reaction.exists?(reaction.id)
  end

  test 'invalid content persists nothing and reports validation errors' do
    ['', 'x' * 17].each do |content|
      assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
        post card_comment_reactions_path(@comment.card, @comment), params: { reaction: { content: content } },
                                                                   as: :turbo_stream
      end
      assert_response :unprocessable_entity
      assert_includes response.body, 'Content'
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

class ReactionRepairTransactionTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test 'committed creation and deletion publish on the subscribed card stream' do
    comment = comments(:logo_agreement_jz)
    messages = []
    subscriber = ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe('broadcast.action_cable') do |*arguments|
      payload = arguments.last
      messages << payload[:message] if payload[:broadcasting] == comment.card.to_gid_param
    end
    reaction = comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:kevin), content: 'committed')
    assert messages.any? { |message| message.include?('committed') }, 'Committed creation was not published'
    messages.clear
    reaction.destroy!
    assert messages.any? { |message| message.include?(ActionView::RecordIdentifier.dom_id(reaction)) },
           'Committed deletion was not published'
    refute Reaction.exists?(reaction.id)
  ensure
    ActiveSupport::Notifications.unsubscribe(subscriber) if subscriber
  end

  test 'rolled back creation and deletion do not broadcast' do
    comment = comments(:logo_agreement_jz)
    original = comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:kevin), content: 'keep')
    messages = []
    subscriber = ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe('broadcast.action_cable') do |*arguments|
      event = ActiveSupport::Notifications::Event.new(*arguments)
      messages << event.payload[:message] if event.payload[:broadcasting] == comment.card.to_gid_param
    end
    Reaction.transaction(requires_new: true) do
      comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:david), content: 'rollback')
      original.destroy!
      raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
    end
    assert_empty messages
    assert Reaction.exists?(original.id)
    refute comment.reactions.exists?(content: 'rollback')
  ensure
    ActiveSupport::Notifications.unsubscribe(subscriber) if subscriber
  end
end

require_relative 'verification_test'
require_relative 'authorization_test'
require_relative 'transaction_test'

class VerifierTest
  test 'the rendered deletion control submits DELETE to the requested record' do
    comment.scroll_to(:center)
    react 'form-check'
    reaction('form-check').click
    record = @comment.reactions.find_by!(content: 'form-check')
    assert_selector 'button.reaction__delete'
    button = comment.find('button.reaction__delete')
    form = button.ancestor('form')
    assert_equal card_comment_reaction_path(@card, @comment, record), URI.parse(form[:action]).path
    assert_equal 'post', form[:method].downcase
    assert_equal 'delete', form.find('input[name="_method"]', visible: :all).value
    assert_includes button.text, 'Remove reaction'
    button.click
    assert_no_text 'form-check'
    refute Reaction.exists?(record.id)
  end

  test 'broadcast controls belong to the viewer rather than the sender' do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      sign_in_as users(:david)
      visit card_url(@card)
      wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    end
    comment.scroll_to(:center)
    react 'viewer-control'
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      assert_text 'viewer-control', wait: 5
      reaction('viewer-control').click
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__delete'
    end
    reaction('viewer-control').click
    assert_selector 'button.reaction__delete'
  end

  test 'a rejected submission preserves its draft and can be corrected' do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    comment.scroll_to(:center)
    within comment do
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      page.execute_script("arguments[0].removeAttribute('maxlength')", find('.reaction__input'))
      find('.reaction__input').set 'x' * 17
      find('.reaction__submit-btn').click
      assert_selector '[role="alert"]', text: 'Content'
      assert_equal 'x' * 17, find('.reaction__input').value
      refute find('.reaction__input').disabled?
      find('.reaction__input').set 'corrected'
      find('.reaction__submit-btn').click
      assert_text 'corrected'
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__input'
    end
    assert_equal 1, @comment.reactions.where(content: 'corrected').count
  end

  test 'deletion reaches another viewer without replacing their draft' do
    comment.scroll_to(:center)
    react 'live-delete'
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      sign_in_as users(:david)
      visit card_url(@card)
      wait_for_cable_subscriptions
      comment.scroll_to(:center)
      assert_text 'live-delete'
      reaction('live-delete').click
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__delete'
      within comment do
        find('.reactions__trigger').click
        find('.reaction__input').set 'draft'
      end
    end
    reaction('live-delete').click
    comment.find('.reaction__delete').click
    assert_no_text 'live-delete'
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      assert_no_text 'live-delete'
      assert_equal 'draft', comment.find('.reaction__input').value
    end
  end

  test 'an explicit refresh preserves a composing viewer' do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    comment.scroll_to(:center)
    within comment do
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      find('.reaction__input').set 'unsaved'
    end
    page.execute_script(<<~JS)
      addEventListener('turbo:morph', () => document.body.dataset.repairMorph = 'yes', { once: true })
    JS
    Turbo::StreamsChannel.broadcast_refresh_to(@card)
    assert_selector 'body[data-repair-morph="yes"]', wait: 5
    assert comment.has_selector?('.reaction__input'), 'Refresh removed the open composer'
    assert_equal 'unsaved', comment.find('.reaction__input').value
  end

  test 'cancel resets only the local composer without persisting a reaction' do
    before = Reaction.count
    comment.scroll_to(:center)
    within comment do
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      find('.reaction__input').set 'cancelled'
      find('.reaction__cancel-btn').click
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__input'
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      assert_equal '', find('.reaction__input').value
    end
    assert_equal before, Reaction.count
  end
end

    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(@comment.card, @comment, other), as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :not_found
    assert Reaction.exists?(own.id)
    assert Reaction.exists?(other.id)
  end

  test 'a missing reaction ID never falls back to an owned record' do
    own = @comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:kevin), content: 'mine')
    assert_no_difference('Reaction.count') do
      delete card_comment_reaction_path(@comment.card, @comment, 'missing'), as: :turbo_stream
    end
    assert_response :not_found
    assert Reaction.exists?(own.id)

class ReactionRepairTransactionTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test 'committed creation and deletion publish on the subscribed card stream' do
    comment = comments(:logo_agreement_jz)
    messages = []
    subscriber = ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe('broadcast.action_cable') do |*arguments|
      payload = arguments.last
      messages << payload[:message] if payload[:broadcasting] == comment.card.to_gid_param
    end
    reaction = comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:kevin), content: 'committed')
    assert messages.any? { |message| message.include?('committed') }, 'Committed creation was not published'
    messages.clear
    reaction.destroy!
    assert messages.any? { |message| message.include?(ActionView::RecordIdentifier.dom_id(reaction)) },
           'Committed deletion was not published'
    refute Reaction.exists?(reaction.id)
  ensure
    ActiveSupport::Notifications.unsubscribe(subscriber) if subscriber
  end

  test 'rolled back creation and deletion do not broadcast' do
    comment = comments(:logo_agreement_jz)
    original = comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:kevin), content: 'keep')
    messages = []
    subscriber = ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe('broadcast.action_cable') do |*arguments|
      event = ActiveSupport::Notifications::Event.new(*arguments)
      messages << event.payload[:message] if event.payload[:broadcasting] == comment.card.to_gid_param
    end
    Reaction.transaction(requires_new: true) do
      comment.reactions.create!(creator: users(:david), content: 'rollback')
      original.destroy!
      raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
    end
    assert_empty messages
    assert Reaction.exists?(original.id)
    refute comment.reactions.exists?(content: 'rollback')
  ensure
    ActiveSupport::Notifications.unsubscribe(subscriber) if subscriber
  end
end

  end

    wait_for_cable_subscriptions

      visit card_url(@card)
      wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    end

    react 'viewer-control'
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      assert_text 'viewer-control', wait: 5
      reaction('viewer-control').click
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__delete'
    end
    reaction('viewer-control').click
    assert_selector 'button.reaction__delete'
  end

  test 'a rejected submission preserves its draft and can be corrected' do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    comment.scroll_to(:center)
    within comment do
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      page.execute_script("arguments[0].removeAttribute('maxlength')", find('.reaction__input'))
      find('.reaction__input').set 'x' * 17
      find('.reaction__submit-btn').click
      assert_selector '[role="alert"]', text: 'Content'
      assert_equal 'x' * 17, find('.reaction__input').value
      refute find('.reaction__input').disabled?
      find('.reaction__input').set 'corrected'
      find('.reaction__submit-btn').click
      assert_text 'corrected'
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__input'
    end
    assert_equal 1, @comment.reactions.where(content: 'corrected').count
  end

  test 'deletion reaches another viewer without replacing their draft' do
    comment.scroll_to(:center)
    react 'live-delete'
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      sign_in_as users(:david)
      visit card_url(@card)
      wait_for_cable_subscriptions
      comment.scroll_to(:center)
      assert_text 'live-delete'
      reaction('live-delete').click
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__delete'
      within comment do
        find('.reactions__trigger').click
        find('.reaction__input').set 'draft'
      end
    end
    reaction('live-delete').click
    comment.find('.reaction__delete').click
    assert_no_text 'live-delete'
    Capybara.using_session(:david) do
      assert_no_text 'live-delete'
      assert_equal 'draft', comment.find('.reaction__input').value
    end
  end

  test 'an explicit refresh preserves a composing viewer' do
    wait_for_cable_subscriptions
    comment.scroll_to(:center)
    within comment do
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      find('.reaction__input').set 'unsaved'
    end
    page.execute_script(<<~JS)
      addEventListener('turbo:morph', () => document.body.dataset.repairMorph = 'yes', { once: true })
    JS
    Turbo::StreamsChannel.broadcast_refresh_to(@card)
    assert_selector 'body[data-repair-morph="yes"]', wait: 5

    assert_equal 'unsaved', comment.find('.reaction__input').value
  end

      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      find('.reaction__input').set 'cancelled'
      find('.reaction__cancel-btn').click
      assert_no_selector '.reaction__input'
      find('.reactions__trigger').click
      assert_equal '', find('.reaction__input').value
    end
    assert_equal before, Reaction.count
  end
end
